name: UserPreference
label: User Preference
description: Generic per-user key-value settings store (theme mode, density, and any future per-user UI/setting that should ROAM across devices — distinct from device-local localStorage). One row per (owner, pref_key), enforced by a unique index; the client upserts by that pair. Personal: every op is if_owner, so a user only ever reads/writes their own preferences (Administrator bypasses). Named saved list views live in their own richer entity, ListPreference, NOT here.
